screens.title: Shoppable videos on every page
screens.caption: A small floating button opens a 9:16 panel. Each video has its own Shop Now link, plus a follow button for your profile.

screens.title: Set it up in one page
screens.caption: Position, size, pages, follow and shop buttons, phone options, privacy mode and auto-open.

screens.title: Add a video in seconds
screens.caption: Paste the TikTok link, pick the product it sells and an optional cover image. Links are checked when you save.

screens.title: Works with the Instagram and Facebook feeds
screens.caption: Widgets that share a corner stack neatly. In privacy mode nothing loads from the social network until a shopper taps play.
